messages:
alex: deploy-bot alert: canary promote blocked — artifact upload failed on shard s-42 (eu-west-1-2). Holding release window. Any ideas?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary promote blocked for run 67890. reason: multipart-upload-abort rate=6 retries=3 shard=s-42

maya: I see concurrent 504s from s3-proxy logs for that shard, maybe transient network flap. Sam, any infra alerts?

sam: No global infra alert. Node agent shows repeated 502s to internal mirror for ~2m. Looking into routing.

alex: We need decision: pin to last-good-artifact or wait for retries? Release notes are already queued for publish at 10:30.

irene: :thinking_face: if we pin, we have to re-run smoke in prod; if we wait and it self-heals we risk missing change window.

maya: Can we promote using part-4 from mirror (mirror-ttl=30m)? There's a cache that has a copy.

sam: I can force a mirror-promote replay but it takes ~4m and needs a manual deploybot op. Anyone available to run?

alex: I'm available. Let's try mirror replay first. If it fails, we'll pin to last-good and re-run rollout smoke. Sam, can you run replay? I'll watch logs.

sam: Kicking mirror replay: `./tools/mirror-replay --shard s-42 --part 4 --run 67890`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: mirror replay started, job id 9001

alex: logs: `s3proxy 503 read timeout`, then `mirror fetch OK` — looks like partial success, continuing

maya: Canary instances are reporting `checksum mismatch` for part 4 still on 2/3 hosts :grimacing:

alex: Abort if not all hosts inside 5m. Status check at +5m from now.

sam: Mirror replay completed job 9001: success on 2 hosts, fail on host-a due to disk I/O error. Retrying.

irene: Given disk I/O on host-a, recommend pin to last-good artifact to unblock release window. Ops will replace host-a during off-hours.

alex: Agreed. I'll open a manual pin for run 67890 to artifact 67889 (last-good). Sam, please abort remaining retries and set manual_pin.

sam: Aborting retries. Running: `deployctl pin-run --run 67890 --artifact 67889 --reason 'mirror partial; host I/O'`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: manual pin applied. run 67890 pinned to artifact 67889. Canary promote resumed.

maya: Canary smoke passed on all 3 hosts after pin. Release notes scheduled to publish now :tada:

alex: Thanks team. Postmortem next week for shard networking + mirror health. I'll update the release notes timeline in the docs.

irene: Adding action: Replace host-a + add extra mirror replication for critical artifacts.

alex: :thumbsup: closing thread.
